en: The image depicts a lively European square with market stalls and umbrellas. The architecture is distinctly Central European with red-tiled roofs and ornate facades. A statue stands prominently in the square, surrounded by several people. In the background, on a hill, there is a distinctive clock tower and fortified structure. The text on the buildings includes 'DAMEN HUT SALON' and other German signage.
